task_description: Three agents collaborate to develop a software module. Agent 1 writes code based on given requirements, Agent 2 reviews and tests the code, and Agent 3 integrates the changes into the main codebase. The goal is to ensure seamless functionality without any integration issues or bugs.
expected_outcome: The module is developed, reviewed, tested, and integrated without any critical issues, ensuring smooth functionality across the system.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for writing the initial code based on the requirements provided.
Agent 2 reviews the code for potential issues and runs tests to ensure functionality.
Agent 3 integrates the reviewed and tested code into the main branch, ensuring there are no conflicts.
